title: $1,000 in Microsoft in 2000 is now worth this
caption:
In 2000, Microsoft was at the dot-com peak.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:MSFT:2000-01-03} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Microsoft in 2000? 👇
sources: Microsoft price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2000, Microsoft was at the dot-com peak.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:MSFT:2000-01-03}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
